verdict.rationale: gstack documents its own headless component: a persistent headless Chromium daemon behind a compiled CLI ($B). It also has non-interactive behaviors, such as the /autoplan pipeline running review skills sequentially with auto-decisions and an auto-upgrade env flag. However, nothing shows the skill workflows themselves running unattended in a CI pipeline. missing for 10: documented CI/headless invocation of gstack workflows, CI integration examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), non-interactive mode/exit-code semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration of automated runs

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
